html:
Greetings, Agents.

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

Meet the mutants with extraordinary abilities 
who stand on the thin line between Super Hero and Super Villain!

 

In this Update Details, we are introducing the March Update,
featuring the Uncanny X-Men theme.

 

Polaris, Kid Omega, and Dazzler, 
who dominate the battlefield using magnetic force, psionics, and light energy, 
have received New Uniforms and Tier-4 Advancements. 

 

Additionally, Silver Samurai, the master swordsman clad in silver armor, 
joins the world of MARVEL Future Fight with Tier-3 and Tier-4 capabilities.

 

To support our new Agents with their early-game missions, 
we have improved the New Account Support System, 
and a new Agent Growth Training will begin 
to assist both new and veteran Agents in strengthening their heroes.

 

Other improvements to make the game more enjoyable have been added as well, 
so please check the details below!

 

 


▣ One New Hero

 

Check out the abilities of Silver Samurai <Modern>, a skilled warrior 
proficient in martial arts and swordsmanship who can adapt to any combat situation.
* The skill effects of the new hero are based on the maximum skill level stats.

 

 

 

▣ Three New Uniforms


To celebrate the Uncanny X-Men themed update, three new Uniforms have been added.
Check out the abilities of Polaris <Uncanny X-Men>, Kid Omega <Uncanny X-Men>, and Dazzler <X-Song>.
* The skill effects of the new Uniforms are based on the maximum skill level stats.
* The three new Uniforms will be on sale for 40% off during the <March Update Celebration Event> and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and Uniform Room after the Event.

 

 

 

 

 

▣ Polaris, Kid Omega, and Silver Samurai Tier-4

 

Tier-4 Advancements have been added for Polaris, Kid Omega, and Silver Samurai.
They will continue to fight to protect their beliefs and way of life.
* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

 

 


▣ Silver Samurai Tier-3

 

Silver Samurai has received his Tier-3 Ultimate Skill. 
Watch him demonstrate the legendary swordsmanship honed through his years as a mercenary.

 

 

 

 

▣ Fantomex and Exodus Potential Awakening & Transcendence


Fantomex and Exodus will acquire
Potential Awakening & Transcendence through the March Update!
* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

 

 

▣ New Account Support System Improvements & New Missions

 

We have implemented several improvements 
to help new Agents settle into their missions smoothly.

 

1. Early Progression Flow Improvements for New Agents (Tutorial)

 

① Hero & Uniform Distribution
- Specific heroes, uniforms, and currency will be provided to bolster your roster before training begins.

 

 

② World Boss (Phase 1)
- Combat and guidance for World Boss, a core piece of content for many Agents will be provided.

 

 

③ Equipping Uniforms
- Instructions on how to equip uniforms to change appearance and gain powerful buffs will be provided.

 

 

④ Team Setup & Skill Training Room

- Explanations on team effects and tips/testing in the Skill Training Room will be provided.

 

 

 

⑤ World Boss (Phase 2)
- Additional combat and guidance to help Agents master World Boss content will be provided.

 

 

2. Agent Growth Training

 

A new Agent Growth Training guide has been added to help Agents navigate 
ISO-8, Comic Card, Custom Gear, Uru, Artifact, and various game modes.

 

Agent Growth Training is available to all agents (both new and existing) and has no time limit.
* Please note that this content is separate from the ‘Agent Welcome Back Training’ missions.
- Each mission unlocks on a daily basis, and you can receive the rewards shown below upon completing the missions.
- For further information regarding the progress of each mission, please tap the '?' icon.

 

 

- You can access the Agent Growth Training menu by the Agent Guide button at the bottom left of the screen.

 

In Agent Growth Training, completing each mission grants you rewards and Mission Points. 
You can also earn milestone rewards based on your total accumulated Mission Points.

 

 

[Agent Growth Training Main Rewards]

 

 

[Agent Growth Training Mission Point Accumulation Rewards]

 

 

* Through the Position-Based Character Pack you can obtain Tier-3 Hela (Leader), Sunspot (Dealer), and Ancient One (Support)
* Please check the in-game list for items available through the Selectors.
* The list of Artifacts obtainable as rewards is subject to change in the future.

 

3. S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy

 

The missions have been adjusted so Agents can experience all content using the basic heroes provided.

 

 

[S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy Main Rewards]

 

 

4. Improvements to the New Agent 7-Day Check-In Rewards

 

The previous 7-day check-in rewards have been moved to the Agent Growth Training content and have been revamped with the new rewards listed below.

 

 

 

▣ New Artifacts

 

After the March update, Exclusive Passive Skill Artifacts for 
Silver Samurai, and Fantomex will be added.
﻿* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

 

 

▣ New Future Pass Plus Season & Special Icons

 

A new season of Future Pass Plus will begin after the update.

 

[Future Pass Plus Rewards]

 

 

- The Future Pass Plus effects will apply immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.
- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic that has been unlocked will only be applied during the season the Pass was purchased. 
The Pass rewards will only be available during the same season.
- The Future Pass Plus - Mythic can be purchased after purchasing the Future Pass Plus - Legendary.
- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic will not be available for purchase when the season is about to end. 

​​

New Special Icons that will represent Agents have been added.
Collect two new Icons as Future Pass Plus rewards, 
one as an Otherworld Battle reward, and one more from the upcoming Event!

 

[March Update New Special Icon]

 

 

 

 

 

 

▣ New Uniform Collection

 

Check out the new Uniforms inspired by Uncanny X-Men theme.
Complete the collection by achieving the specified conditions and earn a reward.

 

 

 

▣ Update Hot Deals & Other Products

 

1.  Update Hot Deal products have been added.
- Event Schedule: 
After the 3/3 Maintenance - 3/31 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),
After the 3/3 Maintenance - 3/31 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT)
- Find various update celebration products like Hot Deal! 100M Gold Pack, and Hot Deal! Custom Gear Unequip Pack in the Hot Deals category in the Store.
Please check the details in-game after the update.

 

 

2. Some package products visible only to Agents under specific conditions have been improved.
* Please check the in-game Store for detailed components and sales periods.

 

① [Starter Relay for Agents #1–3]: 
- Name changed to “Hero Relay for Agents” and some components of the #2 product have been changed.
② [A chance to get Loki's Uniform!] - Changed to Loki <Young Avengers> uniform.
③ [Premium Support Character Selector Pack] - Purchase price has been lowered.
[Support Character Selector Pack] - Purchase price and Crystal amounts have been lowered.
④ [Premium Comic Card Starter Pack], 
[A Chance of Tier-3 Mega Advancement, A Chance of Advanced Potential Transcendence],
[Purchase All Tier-3 Advancement & Transcendence]
- Crystal amounts have been increased; some components have been added or upgraded.

 

3. New package products visible only to Agents under specific conditions have been added.
[Leader / Dealer / Support Hero Recommendations for New Agents]
: Tier-3 Heroes and their latest uniforms (as of the current update) can be acquired.
* Please check in-game for detailed components and sales periods.

 


▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. Store (Currency): “Recharge Energy (Free)” can now be purchased regardless of current energy amount. 
- Purchasing Recharge Energy (Free) will immediately add Energy x120 to your current balance. 
A cooldown period will apply before the item becomes free again.
During this cooldown, the item will be available for purchase for ‘100 Crystals’.

 

 

2. Giant Boss Raid: Additional Tier-4 materials can now be obtained from the following stages.
- Master Mold: Book of the Vishanti, Soul of the Faltine.
- Galactus: Book of the Vishanti.

 

 

3. World Boss & Alliance Battle: A “View Custom Gear” button has been added to the Select Characters screen, allowing you to check the Custom Gear equipped by each hero.

 

 

4. A “Recommended Skill Combo” display has been added above the skill buttons to help you easily check combos even during combat.
This feature can be toggled ON / OFF under Settings → Arena.
- Applicable Content: Alliance Battle, World Boss, Legendary Battle, Dispatch Mission, Ranked Battle

 

 

5. A new menu has been added where you can view all ongoing passes—including Future Pass, Otherworld Battle Pass, and Event Passes—in one place.
* These passes have been removed from their previous locations and can now only be accessed through this new menu.

 

 

6. The display order of contents has been updated.
① Mission
- Before: Story, Dimension Mission, Multiverse Saga, Dispatch Mission, Epic Quest
- After: Dispatch Mission, Dimension Mission, Story, Epic Quest, Multiverse Saga

 

② Challenge
- Before: Legendary Battle, World Boss, Shadowland, Dimension Rift, Zombie Survival
- After: World Boss, Legendary Battle, Shadowland, Dimension Rift, Zombie Survival

 

7. Store: A checkbox has been added to the Purchase All menu, allowing you to select “Free Items Only.”

 

8. The Red Dot notifications at the top of the screen have been changed to a numerical format.
- The number of obtainable rewards from each category is now displayed to make them easier to recognize.
- Emblem Collection reward notifications have been added to the Navigation list.

 

9. The following item name has been changed.
- Before: Clear Ticket
- After: Sweep Ticket

 

10. The maximum capacity for the following items has been increased.
- M'kraan Shard: 9,000 → 15,000
- M'kraan Crystal: 9,000 → 15,000
- Phoenix Feather: 9,000 → 15,000
- Titan's Records: 10 → 50

 

11. MARVEL Future Fight Content Unlock Requirements have been changed.
- The unlock requirements for most content have been changed to depend on your Dispatch Mission progress.
- Team: Dispatch Mission clear requirements have been added to access certain Gear categories.
- Certain content has been changed to be available at all times.

 

 

12. Story: As new Agents will now receive the basic heroes (Captain America, Iron Man, Black Widow) at Tier-2 upon starting, the First Clear rewards for Story (Normal) have been revamped.
- Before: Tier-2 Captain America, Tier-2 Black Widow, Tier-2 Iron Man
- After: Tier-2 Materials, Tier-3 Materials

 

13. The hit range of Polaris’s Tier-3 Ultimate Skill has been slightly increased.

 

14. Shadowland Shop: The monthly purchase limit for Odin’s Blessing Chest has been adjusted from 2 to 1.

 


▣ Game Error Fixes
 
1. Fixed an issue where the effects and attacks of the 'Wild Card' skill were not functioning correctly when using Gambit <Modern> uniform.

 


We will return with various content improvements, so please stay tuned.


Thank you.
